regimeSub: 10Y blows through 5.30% to 24yr highs as term premium reprices; equities ignore bond carnage.
themes: 10Y yield +3bps to 5.31% (highest since 2002) as Treasury selloff accelerates post-weak NFP (29K vs est) → bear steepener intensifies with 2s10s at +47bps; Capital Brief's 'selloff rolls on' narrative intact

Warsh's Sep 15 hike to 4.0% (first in 3 years) failing to anchor inflation expectations → CPI sticky at 3.7% YoY (Aug), core PCE at 3.0% vs 2% target; Fed Chair's 'inflation is too high' warning proving prescient

SPX rips to 7818 (+0.6% DoD, +15.4% YoY) as equity risk premium compresses to near-zero vs 5.3% yields → VIX at 15.01 signals dangerous complacency; KOSPI at 6876 (+96% YTD per 24/7 Wall St) on HBM mania
Brent +0.8% to $101.65 as Saudi output disruptions linger post-Iran deal (Jun 14 Atlantic Council) → gold punches to $4168 (+0.4%) as stagflation hedge despite rising real rates
